# Workspace guidance

## Project
- Russian-language multiple-choice study app built with React, TypeScript, and Vite.
- Keep the interface responsive, accessible, and visually calm.
- Support JSON question imports, topic sections, immediate answer feedback, and persistence in localStorage.

## Development
- `npm run dev` starts the local development server.
- `npm run build` type-checks and creates a production build.
- `npm run lint` runs ESLint.
- No extra VS Code extensions or custom tasks are required.

## Setup status
- [x] Requirements clarified from the workspace request.
- [x] React + TypeScript + Vite scaffolded in the workspace root.
- [x] Quiz interface, JSON import, sections, feedback, and local persistence implemented.
- [x] Dependencies installed; production build and lint pass.
- [x] README documents launch and JSON format.
- [ ] Launch the development server when requested.
